{{Top|leg}}
The '''Numbness system''' greatly increased the wearer's durability by converting all pain into benign brain signals. It appeared to have no direct negative side effects as its user was still fully aware of the body's current state of health.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 16 or higher.
